content:
marco: Heads-up: new mini-slate going to staging tonight (internal: Price Clarity Surge). Need final FAQ, calc flow, and inbound routing before soft launch.
elaine: For FAQ keep it tiny 13 words max per answer. Three anchors: billing, commitments, security. Link to docs.
kevin: Proposed tier names: Starter / Team / Committed -> Starter, Team, Committed. Add one-line descriptor under each (e.g., 'best for trial teams', 'steady growth', 'reserved capacity').
sam: Routing rec: calculator preview -> SDR queue; email-capture converts -> Growth AE; signals >= $5k -> Enterprise AE. Tag leads with "pcs_estimator".
nina: Calculator UX: instant 2-line preview (monthly est + p95 latency delta). Click "Get full breakdown" opens email modal, then show PDF + tiny table comparing Hosted vs Dedicated p95. Default slider 10k tokens/mo.
marco: Add small benchmark blurb in results: "Representative tests: Hosted API ~120ms median; Dedicated <30ms p95" with link to bench doc. Keep conservative phrasing.
kevin: CTA variants: A) "Estimate your bill" B) "See price range". Also change microcopy under tiers to clarify commit benefits.
elaine: I'll build two FAQ placements in staging: inline vs accordion. A/B test impact on conversions and support clicks.
sam: Webhooks/tags: growth-bot please create tags pcs_estimator_v1 and webinar_pcs_2026 and wire to /hooks/estimator and /hooks/webinar_reg. Also include hidden param src=pcs_estimator on form.
growth-bot: Created tags pcs_estimator_v1 and webinar_pcs_2026. Webhooks configured at /hooks/estimator and /hooks/webinar_reg. Hidden param added.
kevin: UX question: show full dollar amount by default or show ranges? My take: A/B test ranges vs exact to see which improves CTR.
nina: Agree. Also add an "ops impact" toggle to show p95 latency changes for Dedicated vs Hosted. That should help platform buyers.
marco: Analytics events to track: pcs_preview_shown, pcs_email_capture, pcs_submit, faq_expand, faq_doc_click, sales_handshake. Make sales_handshake fire when SFDC owner assigned.
growth-bot: Events registered in LaunchSpec: pcs_preview_shown, pcs_email_capture, pcs_submit, faq_expand, faq_doc_click, sales_handshake.
sam: Timeline: copy freeze tomorrow EOD; staging QA Wed; soft-launch Thu; webinar signup opens Fri. I'll coordinate the two cohort sends (trial cohort + recent estimator users). UTM: ?utm_source=pcs&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=pcs_launch.
marco: Great. I'll compile tasks and ping when copy is final. :thumbsup:
